title: Waves Correctness Gate Schema
description: Structured report from a correctness gate: full-context reviewers (correctness, silent-failure, cross-consistency, plus coverage-gap at post_impl only), each paired with verifier B. Covers BOTH boundaries via the 'boundary' field — post_plan (logbook-create Step A7: 3 reviewers, concrete plan vs real codebase) and post_impl (objectives-implement Step 9.8: 4 reviewers, integrated diff vs assembled system). One schema, not two: the report shape is identical, only the boundary and the input differ (DRY — product_rule #10 + REGLA-0 #3).
$comment: CANONICAL SHAPE: object with keys boundary, target, reviewed_at, model, summary, findings. OPEN (never additionalProperties:false, design_principle #11). STOP: one gate run per file (one boundary value). REDIRECT: the code fixes go in the logbook recent_context + the diff, NOT here; this is the read-only finding+classification record (design_principle #11 — analyses are persisted, mineable). An undeclared sibling field is the signal you are writing the wrong artifact. bad: merging a post_plan run and a post_impl run into one file. good: boundary 'post_plan', findings[] each with a reviewer axis + a verifier-B classification.

boundary.description: Which gate produced this report: post_plan (A7) or post_impl (Step 9.8).

target.description: What was reviewed: the logbook path (post_plan) or the diff range base..head (post_impl).

reviewed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the gate run.

model.description: Model or agent that produced the review.

summary.description: Verifier-B verdict tally for quick reading; full detail is in findings.

findings.description: One entry per finding. An empty array means the gate found nothing actionable — UNLESS degraded is true (then the absence of findings from a fallen lens means 'not reviewed', not 'clean').

degraded.description: True when one or more lenses (or their verifier B) fell during this gate run — the report's coverage claim is partial, never to be read as full coverage.

fallen_lenses.description: Names of the lenses that fell when degraded:true.

finding.description: One correctness finding from a reviewer, carrying its verifier-B classification.
finding.$comment: STOP: one issue per finding, cite file:line. REDIRECT: the applied fix → logbook recent_context; the test that proves it fixed → the primary's verification_demonstrations; do NOT put remediation code here. The verifier B classifies, never vetoes. bad: a finding with no file:line and no classification. good: axis 'silent_failure', file 'state.go', line 42, classification 'confirmed'.

axis.description: Which gate reviewer surfaced this finding (coverage_gap exists only at boundary post_impl).

severity.description: Reviewer severity scale — matches the agents' finding structure (critical = wrong result or destructive action on a common path).

file.description: Path of the file the finding cites.

line.description: Line number, or null for a file/range-level finding.

classification.description: Verifier-B classification (A->B pattern, design_principle #7). Classifies, never vetoes.
